protocol.name: Original Yale B 01..10, fixed controlled-illumination holdout (limited benchmark)

detector_border.applied: after enhancement, gallery and every query identically
detector_border.selected_on: reference enrollment image only, before query inference

scene_labels.acquisition_failure_no_flash: 原库记录的闪光未触发
scene_labels.ambient_no_flash: 无闪光环境光（不等同夜间）
scene_labels.controlled_rear_side: 受控背侧光（非实景强逆光）

limitations: Original cropped data, no independent capture sessions
Images were acquired in approximately two seconds under changing strobes
Single-face presence is not IoU localization validation
No actual IR, field low-light, or bright-background backlight labels
Original 01..10 only; extra subjects in mirror are not used
Documented flash failures have their own scene; mild source field imbalance is flagged, not filtered using model scores

split_audit.rule: gallery > calibration > test; retain first canonical-pixel image; filenames/labels and source ordering fixed before inference

time_scope: enhancement+detection+embedding+search; concurrent CPU workers; not a dedicated speed benchmark
